defuss-shadcn / Website / Showcase / showcase-bouldering

Bouldering Gym

A one-page site for a bouldering gym - contour lines under the hero, climbing holds scattered over the page, the week's new problems by grade and colour, the setter's beta in a speech bubble and a day pass as a ticket. Three looks: Chalk, Night session and Granite. One of the Showcase sites.

Open full screen

Grip, bouldering in Bochum

The Look select switches the wall: Chalk (white, the holds in their tape colours), Night session (dark, the holds glowing) and Granite (grey stone, a grain under everything). The contour lines are a slow Shader (topography), coloured by the look; the holds are corner-blob shapes; the grades are the Fontainebleau scale.

×%

Composed from Button, Select, Avatar, a Shader (the contour lines drifting under the hero), a Surface (grain under the Granite look) and shapes.css (the corner-blob holds, the ticket pass). The grades are the Fontainebleau scale the gym's tape uses.
